home.description: Discover Rivington Marx Interiors, a Denver-based luxury interior design firm that creates timeless, high-end residential spaces nationwide.
paragraphs: Luxury Interior Design. Denver Based. Projects Nationwide.

Rivington Marx Interiors is a nationally recognized boutique interior architecture and design firm based in Denver, Colorado. Our skilled team of award-winning professionals provides unmatched residential design services locally and nationwide. Whether starting from scratch or looking to refresh a beloved space, Rivington Marx Interiors can transform your home and decor into the space of your dreams.
Portfolio
Services
About
Rivington Marx – Design Done Differently
Bespoke Design Intelligence
We believe a home should do more than impress. It should reveal something true.

Too often, interior design is reduced to surface decisions and borrowed aesthetics. Spaces are styled for approval rather than lived experience, shaped by trends instead of intention. We reject that approach entirely.

Design, to us, is an act of intention. Every environment we create is informed by how life actually unfolds: quiet mornings, evolving rituals, moments of gathering and retreat. Every line, material, and proportion is chosen with purpose. Nothing exists to serve aesthetic performance alone.

Our work is deeply bespoke and rooted in clarity. We do not impose a signature style or recycle concepts. Instead, we translate personal narratives, architecture, and long-term use into spaces that feel considered, enduring, and quietly confident.
Specialized Workflow Systems
Exceptional design requires disciplined execution. From the outset, we map out what matters, what comes next, and where teams can work more efficiently.
The result is a smoother creative process with fewer hold-ups and less unnecessary spending.
This system allows us to:
Reduce unnecessary revisions
Control costs without compromising quality
Streamline approvals and selections
Maintain momentum throughout the project
Efficiency, for us, is not a shortcut. It is a form of respect. For the client, the design, and the process itself.
Integrated Design + Construction
Fragmentation is the enemy of great outcomes. We match vision with execution from the start by combining design and construction.
Our teams bring different areas of expertise to the same table. This helps protect the original design, catch issues early, and carry the vision through construction.
This integrated approach creates:
Fewer handoffs and clearer accountability
Reduced redundancies and delays
Greater budget transparency
A more seamless client experience
Design and construction are not separate conversations. We ensure they speak the same language.
Together, these principles result in a more mindful way of working. One that values innovation, appreciates the process, and creates long-lasting environments.

Rather than go with a traditional arrangement in one of the rooms, as we wanted, Troy influenced our decision and took us out of our comfort zone. We are so grateful that he did. To this day, it is the most complimented and appreciated part of the design.
Matt & Lance, Denver, CO

pages.title: About the Rivington Marx Team
pages.description: Discover how our Denver interior designers craft bold, timeless spaces through a boutique, client-focused approach.
paragraphs: Every decision blends creativity, logic, and wonder

Founded in Denver, Rivington Marx Interiors is a nationally recognized boutique interior architecture and design firm. Our skilled team of award-winning professionals provides unmatched residential design services locally and nationwide.

Unlike some other interior designers, Rivington Marx Interiors looks beyond common retail offerings, providing our clients with pieces not to be found in local chains or ( gasp! ) in your neighbor’s home. If you are looking for a design team who avoids trends in favor of designing something newly iconic, Rivington Marx Interiors is for you.
In every project we have one goal in mind: creating something unexpected, awe-inspiring, and deeply personal.

Dedicated to timeless home design, we create indelible interior spaces that blend bespoke and avant-garde styles with classical and modern inspirations. Our refined approach incorporates your personal preferences into an elevated design that complements your lifestyle, resulting in a well-appointed home that is distinctly your own.
Troy Rivington
Principal | Chief Creative Officer | Dream Maker

Troy is the co-founder of Rivington Marx Interiors and brings decades of experience in interior design and unique home decor to the firm. Troy’s dedication to excellence and client satisfaction has established him as a respected figure in the interior design community.
Clients trust us with their sacred spaces. We honor that trust by ensuring every decision we make blends creativity, logic, and wonder.

Before founding Rivington Marx Interiors, Troy was a business owner and entrepreneur and led design projects of all sizes for a prominent Colorado firm as creative director, earning industry awards and collaborating on notable projects such as the reimagining of a historic Curtis Park mansion in Denver, which was prominently featured in LUXE magazine.

At Rivington Marx Interiors, Troy leads the creative vision of interior design projects, ensuring each one reflects his commitment to innovative and sophisticated design. Clients especially value his ability to seamlessly blend modern aesthetics with timeless, storied elements, delivering beautiful spaces that are both functional and captivating.
Chandra Marx
Principal | Chief Executive Officer | Focus Keeper

As co-founder of Rivington Marx Interiors, Chandra provides years of expertise and passion to her role. She ensures each project meets the highest standards of quality and service, with a sharp focus on client satisfaction, operational efficiency, and relationship-building.
The foundation of great interior design firms is a well-managed and thoughtfully-organized system of support for clients and design teams.

After graduating from the University of Colorado Boulder, Chandra found early success in leadership roles within national corporations. She spent 12 years managing operations across seven offices in three states and honed her expertise in scaling businesses and fostering client relationships.

Chandra later transitioned to the interior design world, where she’s been for more than 10 years, playing a pivotal role in business growth and client relations. Chandra’s meticulous approach to planning showcases her deep understanding of interior design operations and Rivington Marx Interiors’ commitment to excellence.
Annie Martin
Partner | Director of Interior Architecture | Style Bringer

Annie is a visionary designer whose holistic approach is expertly complemented by her attention to detail. Her expertise spans the entire design process—from architectural planning to finishing touches—with a focus on fostering connection and expressing individuality through design.
The transformative power of design can improve daily life, create emotional connections, and turn visions into reality.

Annie earned her bachelor’s degree in residential interior design from the University of Georgia. Before joining the Rivington Marx design team, she worked on luxury home projects alongside renowned architects and designers in Atlanta, where she mastered the intricacies of ground-up project management and construction.

Annie is known for her meticulous attention to detail, and she views her work as both an honor and a responsibility. Annie’s ability to conceptualize and execute designs makes her a trusted partner for clients looking to elevate their space.
Eric Knuth
Partner | Director of Operations | Canvas Creator

Eric’s role as the director of operations at Rivington Marx Interiors helps bridge the gap between concept and reality, and his extensive experience ensures our design team has a perfect canvas on which to showcase our designs. Clients feel confident knowing that Eric considers their homes cherished spaces and that every part of a project is carefully considered before a single hammer swings or a paint brush touches a wall.
Carefully planned and executed construction creates the space in which brilliant interior designs come to life.

A true Colorado native, Eric’s enthusiasm for working with his hands began early in life. He spent his younger years in rural Douglas County, developing his talents on construction projects alongside his father and brother. Today, Eric upholds the highest quality standards for our clients and projects.

pages.title: Our Luxury Interior Design Services in Denver
pages.description: We provide full-service interior design, including space planning, architectural review, furniture selection, and project management.
paragraphs: At Rivington Marx Interiors, our celebrated team of designers specializes in transforming homes into highly personalized works of art, shaped with precision and intention. Every project begins with a deep appreciation for context, architecture, and individual expression, helping each home reflect both its setting and the lifestyle of its owner.
Our Services
Interior Design
LEARN MORE
Kitchen Design
Bathroom Design
Home Remodeling
Design Build
Architectural Design
It all begins with a conversation

Our process is comprehensive and highly curated. From thoughtfully appointed furnishings to full-scale renovations and new-build residences, we bring expertise and exacting attention to projects of every scale.
For more complex undertakings, we integrate interior design, architectural planning, construction, and project management to create results that feel functional, cohesive, and timeless.
Our promise is to shape spaces that reflect who you are today while standing as enduring expressions of beauty, elegance, and possibility.

Begin your design journey with a private consultation at Rivington Marx Interiors, where we listen closely to your aspirations and explore how they can shape a personalized approach to your home. Together, we consider every aspect of the project, from the larger design vision and spatial flow to the curated furnishings, lighting, art, and accessories that bring each room to life.
Our interior design services include:
Full-home space planning and furniture layouts
Color palette development
Decorative and architectural lighting specifications
Tile, stone, and flooring selection, including pattern design
Hardware, plumbing fixture, and finish coordination
Paint and wall finish selection
Furniture selection and custom upholstery
Window treatment selection and detailing
Art curation, placement, and installation coordination
Styling with accessories, objects, and soft goods
Procurement support and installation oversight

We keep the experience clear, collaborative, and enjoyable from beginning to end. Your preferences help shape the creative direction, while we pay close attention to how each room needs to look, feel, and function. The finished home feels polished and welcoming, with details that belong together rather than competing for attention.

Collaborate with Rivington Marx Interiors’ award-winning kitchen design team to create a space that feels beautiful, highly functional, and closely connected to the rest of your home. From cabinetry and appliance placement to lighting and material selections, every detail is considered as part of one cohesive design.
Our kitchen design expertise includes:
Fully custom cabinetry design, specification, supply, and installation
Space planning and layout optimization
Kitchen lighting design
Material, countertop, hardware, and fixture selection
Appliance integration and ergonomic planning
Construction documents and cabinetry elevations
Plumbing, electrical, and trade coordination
Remodel management from concept through construction
Styling and final installation coordination

With kitchen design handled in-house, architecture, cabinetry, construction, and the finishing details stay connected from the start. Clients get a clearer process, and the design carries through more consistently from the first plans to the final installation.

A well-designed bathroom should support the rhythms of daily life while still feeling considered and restorative. Our bathroom design team develops personalized spaces that balance comfort, storage, lighting, materials, and long-term functionality.
Our bathroom design services include:
Bathroom layout planning and space optimization
Custom vanity and cabinetry design
Tile, stone, flooring, and surface selection
Decorative and architectural lighting design
Plumbing fixture, hardware, and finish specification
Shower, tub, and wet-area planning
Construction drawings and elevations
Plumbing, electrical, and construction coordination
Remodel oversight and installation coordination

Each bathroom is designed in relation to the architecture and character of the larger home. Our team guides every selection with care so the finished space feels polished, purposeful, and distinctly personal.

Rivington Marx Interiors manages home remodeling projects with careful planning, structured oversight, and close coordination between the design and construction teams. By considering architecture, interiors, and field execution together, we help protect the larger design vision throughout every phase of the remodel.
Our home remodeling services include:
Full-home and multi-room renovations
Kitchen and bathroom remodeling
Interior reconfigurations and additions
Construction planning and sequencing
Coordination with builders, subcontractors, and tradespeople
Review of drawings, elevations, and specifications
Quality control and installation oversight
Timeline and project coordination
On-site problem-solving with a design-led approach
By keeping design decisions and field execution closely connected, we help each phase move forward with greater clarity and alignment.

Our design-build approach brings design and construction together from the earliest stages of a project. Rather than treating each discipline as a separate process, Rivington Marx Interiors coordinates creative direction, architectural planning, budgeting, construction, and installation as parts of one complete vision.
Our design-build services include:
Early project evaluation and feasibility planning
Integrated interior design and construction coordination
Preliminary scope, budget, and scheduling guidance
Architectural and interior drawing development
Material, finish, fixture, and furnishing specifications
Coordination with architects, engineers, builders, and fabricators
Construction management and quality oversight
Coordination of custom cabinetry and architectural details
Procurement and installation coordination
Final styling and project completion

This integrated model helps reduce gaps between what is designed and what is built. Clients benefit from clearer communication, stronger continuity, and a team that remains closely involved from the first concept through the final reveal.

Rivington Marx Interiors works closely with architects and builders to ensure that interior architecture is considered with precision from the beginning. Every component, including flooring, cabinetry, lighting, millwork, hardware, and spatial relationships, is carefully designed to support the long-term functionality of the house as well as the architectural objective.
Our interior architectural design and drafting services include:
Comprehensive drawing sets for remodels and interior space reconfigurations
Floor plans, reflected ceiling plans, elevations, and custom details
Lighting, electrical, plumbing, and audiovisual layout coordination
Window and door coordination as part of the interior architectural plan
CAD-drafted plans
Detailed millwork and cabinetry drawings
Oversight of custom architectural fabrication
Collaboration with architects, builders, engineers, and specialty fabricators
Review of architectural plans through an interior design lens

Careful planning keeps architecture, construction, and interior design moving in the same direction. That coordination shows in the finished home, where the layout, details, and everyday function feel naturally connected.

pages.title: Denver Interior Design Firm
pages.description: Work with a leading Denver interior designer who creates custom, architectural interiors tailored to your lifestyle. Rivington Marx delivers timeless, refined design.
paragraphs: Rivington Marx Interiors is a nationally recognized boutique interior design firm. Our skilled team of award-winning professionals provides unmatched residential design services locally and nationwide.
It all begins with a conversation
Experience in Every Detail of Luxury Interior Design

At Rivington Marx Interiors , our award-winning designers bring exceptional artistry and insight to every project. Their work has been featured in Luxe Interiors + Design, House Beautiful, and Colorado Homes & Lifestyles for projects that create a seamless balance of refined elegance and individual expression.

Headquartered in Denver, yet shaping distinguished projects across the country, Rivington Marx Interiors continues to define a new benchmark in modern luxury, crafting spaces that are beautiful and distinctive.
Full-Service Luxury Interior Design for the Way You Live

Your home should feel as comfortable as it is refined. As a leading Denver interior design firm, our full service luxury design services guide you through the entire process, from concept to installation.
Our services include:

Comprehensive space planning and concept creation: We begin by studying how you live and move through your home, designing interiors that balance flow, comfort, and sophistication. Every plan reflects timeless design principles that make daily life both beautiful and functional.

Color palette development and material coordination: Every hue and texture is selected to create harmony. From stone and metal to fabrics and finishes, we curate combinations that blend traditional and modern elements for a sense of timeless elegance.

Complete project management and builder collaboration: Our team oversees every phase, coordinating with contractors and trades to keep your project organized, efficient, and true to the design vision.

Tile, stone, and flooring selection with custom pattern design: From hand-selected marble to artisan tile layouts, we design surfaces that elevate the architecture and add lasting character to your home.

Lighting design, layout, and specification: We craft layered lighting plans that balance function and mood, highlighting architectural details, vibrant colors, and rich materials for a perfectly illuminated home.
Hardware, plumbing, and fixture selection: We source distinctive hardware and fixtures that complement the architecture, combining performance with subtle luxury and high-quality craftsmanship.
Paint and specialty wall finish coordination: From custom paint palettes to plaster and lacquer finishes, we create visual depth and atmosphere that complete the space.
Furniture selection and custom upholstery: Our designs include bespoke and curated furnishings, designed for comfort and proportion, tailored to fit your home perfectly.
Window treatment detailing and soft goods styling: Draperies, shades, and textiles are designed with precision to frame views, filter light, and add softness to your interiors.
Accessory and art curation for a finished, livable space: We help you layer your home with meaningful pieces, art, books, and objects that make it feel complete and authentically yours.
Procurement support and on-site installation oversight: Every item is carefully tracked, inspected, and installed under our direction to ensure the final reveal matches the approved vision.
New Construction & Integrated Interior Design

Guided by Denver’s most talented and experienced interior designers, Rivington Marx Interiors partners closely with architects and builders to align every detail and interior finish, creating a unified design that feels effortless yet fully integrated.
Our involvement includes:
Collaboration with architects and builders to preserve design intent
Full specifications for flooring, cabinetry, lighting, and millwork
Kitchen and bath design tailored to lifestyle and investment priorities
Thorough documentation for flawless construction and smooth approvals
The result is a home defined by timeless design, high-quality materials, and thoughtful details.
Remodel and Renovation Design with In-House Construction

Rivington Marx Interiors delivers the distinct advantage of an in-house construction division that collaborates seamlessly with our designers throughout every renovation and remodel. This integrated design-build approach removes the typical stress of remodeling by uniting design, planning, and construction within one aligned team. The result is streamlined communication, precise timelines, and highly accurate execution.
Our renovation and remodel services include:
Full interior remodel planning and design
Direct project management and construction oversight
Streamlined scheduling and budgeting
Consistent supervision to maintain quality and design intent
From strategic upgrades to full scale transformations, we deliver refined spaces that blend beauty and functionality. Your new home will look exceptional and feel intentional.
Our Design Process, Refined from Start to Finish

Every Rivington Marx Interiors project follows a thoughtful, proven process designed to make the experience as seamless as it is inspiring. From the first conversation to the final installation, every phase is guided by clarity, collaboration, and attention to detail.
Initial Consultation – We begin by understanding your goals, lifestyle, and vision for your home, setting the foundation for a truly personal design.

pages.title: A Heritage of Kitchen Remodel and Design Excellence
pages.description: Rivington Marx Interiors brings together architectural precision and creative vision to reimagine what a kitchen can be. Contact us for a consultation.
paragraphs: Rivington Marx offers kitchen remodeling and design in Denver for homeowners who want a more thoughtful, fully tailored space. Projects may include layout planning, custom cabinetry, quartz or quartzite surfaces, appliance integration, construction coordination, and refined finish selection across Denver and nearby neighborhoods.
It all begins with a conversation

Rivington Marx Interiors brings together architectural precision and creative vision to reimagine what a kitchen can be. Every kitchen remodel and design project is led by interior designers who treat the space as both a functional hub and a beautifully finished part of your home.

Our work can be found in some of Denver’s most beautiful homes, from restored historic properties to modern builds in neighborhoods like Cherry Creek, Hilltop, and Washington Park. Each kitchen is designed with care, thought, and originality, then tailored to the people who call it home.

Rivington Marx Interiors partner and Director of Interior Architecture, Annie Martin has seen her award-winning kitchen designs featured in LUXE Interiors + Design, House Beautiful, and Colorado Homes & Lifestyles. These recognitions reflect our ongoing dedication to craftsmanship, integrity, and refined design. Clients choose us because they know their kitchen will be personal, functional, and timeless.
What’s Included in Our Kitchen Design & Remodel Service

Every kitchen is a layered experience. Our talented designers combine architecture, craftsmanship, and detail to create your dream kitchen, a cohesive and personal space where every element feels intentional. Your kitchen becomes a space that invites gathering, calm, and effortless daily living while expressing your style and personality.
Architectural Space Planning Every kitchen remodel starts with the layout. Floor plans are refined around flow, storage, prep space, sightlines, and how the kitchen connects to the rest of the home.

Custom Cabinetry & Millwork Custom cabinetry is designed for the home, not pulled from a template. For kitchen remodeling in Denver, that often includes custom millwork, kitchen storage systems, appliance garages, pull-out storage, drawer organizers, concealed panels, and custom pantry solutions developed with Nickels Cabinetry and local fabricators.

Finish & Material Selection Materials are selected to feel polished, durable, and easy to live with. That may include quartz countertops, quartzite countertops, marble, wood flooring, tile, hardware, and wall finishes chosen to suit the architecture of the space.

Countertops, Surfaces, & Backsplashes Surface details do a lot of the heavy lifting in a high-end kitchen remodel Denver homeowners can truly live in. Depending on the project, that may include quartz or quartzite surfaces, slab backsplash details, waterfall edges, and other integrated stone elements.
Lighting & Detailing Lighting helps the kitchen feel finished, not flat. Plans usually combine task lighting, ambient lighting, and accent lighting to bring warmth, clarity, and depth to the room.

Luxury Appliance Integration Appliances are considered early in the kitchen design build process, not added at the end. Designs can accommodate Sub Zero appliances, Wolf appliances, panel ready appliances, built-in refrigeration, and integrated ventilation while keeping the overall look clean and cohesive.
Why Homeowners Choose Rivington Marx Interiors

Homeowners across Denver come to Rivington Marx when they want more than a kitchen update. They want a space that feels fully considered, with strong design, real livability, and a finished result that does not lose its way somewhere between the drawings and the build.

Rivington Marx offers a design build approach to kitchen remodeling in Denver, managing both the creative and construction side of the project. That keeps communication tighter, helps protect the design intent, and cuts down on the disconnect that can happen when design and execution are split between separate teams.
A few qualities tend to stand out throughout that process:
Architectural-Level Design: Every project begins with structure and proportion.
Exclusivity: Designs and Materials are unique to your project, guaranteeing your home remains truly distinctive.
Holistic Vision: We consider the entire home, ensuring your kitchen flows seamlessly with adjoining spaces.

In House Construction: Rivington Marx Interiors provides both full service design and construction in house, creating a more seamless kitchen remodeling process with closer control over execution, coordination, and design integrity.
Refined Craftsmanship: Every detail, from lighting to millwork, is designed with care and purpose.
A Glimpse Inside Our Luxury Designs

Every Rivington Marx kitchen remodel and interior design project tells its own story. Our kitchen design ideas blend how people cook, gather, and rest at home with refined craftsmanship and balance. From elegant kitchen renovations in historic Denver homes to new kitchen designs in mountain retreats, each space reflects warmth, texture, and timeless style.
Our Design Process, Refined from Start to Finish

A strong kitchen remodel does not come together by winging it. Rivington Marx moves through each phase with a clear plan, so the design stays sharp and the construction side does not drift off course.

Design Development This is where the kitchen starts to take real shape. The team works through space planning , appliance layout, cabinetry design, material selections, lighting, and finishes so the room feels resolved before construction begins.

Construction Documentation Once the design is set, everything is translated into detailed drawings. That includes cabinetry shop drawings, trade coordination plans, and permit documentation when the project requires it.

Procurement and Ordering After approvals, ordering begins and long lead items are tracked closely. Cabinetry fabrication, appliance ordering, and stone slab selection all happen in this phase, with cabinetry and appliances often taking the most time.

Construction and Installation This is the build phase, where the plan moves off the page and into the home. Work may include demolition, rough plumbing, electrical, cabinetry installation, stone fabrication, tile, and finishing, with site visits several times each week to keep quality and design intent aligned.

Each kitchen remodel follows its own timeline based on scope, selections, permitting, and construction complexity. During the planning phase, we provide a clear project roadmap so clients know what to expect at each stage.
Kitchen Remodeling and Design Serving Denver Neighborhoods

Kitchen remodeling in Denver rarely happens in a blank box. Many homes come with existing architecture, older layouts, and structural quirks that need a more thoughtful approach, especially in high end neighborhoods where character matters as much as function.
Rivington Marx works on kitchen remodel projects in areas such as:
Cherry Hills
Denver Country Club
Cherry Creek
Hilltop
Washington Park
Castle Pines
Construction Oversight That Protects the Design

Good design can fall apart in the field if nobody is paying close attention. Rivington Marx stays involved through construction with frequent site visits, trusted trade partners, and steady coordination across subcontractors so the work stays aligned with the design drawings.
That includes shop drawing review, construction progress checks, and oversight of key phases such as plumbing, electrical, tile, and finish installation.
With trade partner coordination and subcontractor management handled closely, the project is more likely to feel consistent from the first drawing to the final details.
Begin Your Kitchen Transformation

Designing a kitchen with Rivington Marx Interiors is an experience rooted in creativity, collaboration, and trust. We guide each project from concept to completion, creating kitchens that feel effortless, functional, and deeply personal.
Ready to reimagine the heart of your home? Book a private design consultation today and discover what’s possible when architecture meets artistry.
FAQs
How do I start a kitchen re-design and remodel with Rivington Marx?

We start with a private consultation to understand your home, your goals, and how you want the kitchen to feel and function. After that, we share a proposal that outlines scope, timeline, and next steps.
Do you handle both the design and kitchen remodel process?
Yes. We guide the full process, from layout and design decisions to selections, documentation, and coordination during construction, so the experience feels clear and connected from start to finish.
How long does a luxury kitchen remodel take?

Timeline depends on the scope of the remodel, the level of customization, material lead times, and any permitting involved. During the planning process, we outline the project phases clearly so you have a realistic sense of timing before work begins.
How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Denver?

Square footage, structural modifications, custom cabinetry, appliance choices, stone materials, and the degree of final detail all affect how much a kitchen renovation in Denver will cost. Because Rivington Marx specializes in customized, upscale kitchens, pricing is established during the design phase following the definition of the project’s scope and choices.

paragraphs: Luxury Bathroom Remodel & Design Service in Denver

At Rivington Marx Interiors, we transform bathrooms into elegant, timeless sanctuaries that blend function with refined beauty. Every detail, from proportion and layout to texture and lighting, is designed to feel effortless and personal.
It all begins with a conversation
Bathroom Design Rooted in Experience and Trust

Our bathroom designs are led by architectural interior designers who understand how structure, flow, and light shape the way you live. Every project begins with a clear vision to create a space that feels both luxurious and deeply personal.

Rivington Marx Interiors designers have earned recognition in publications such as LUXE Interiors + Design, House Beautiful, and Colorado Homes & Lifestyles for its commitment to craftsmanship and originality. Our reputation across Denver and beyond is built on thoughtful design and precise execution.

Each bathroom is an original creation, designed to fit seamlessly within the character and architecture of your home. Clients trust us not only for our design skills but for the way we handle every stage of the remodel, with transparency, care, and respect.
Our Bathroom Design & Remodel Services
Each design is guided by architectural precision and brought to life with materials, finishes, and details selected exclusively for your home.

Full Bathroom Remodels Our full bathroom renovation and remodels reimagine your space from the ground up, blending function and style for lasting comfort. We start with a detailed review of layout, light fixtures, and floor planning to ensure every small bathroom or large suite works beautifully. The result is a seamless, high-end bathroom remodel that feels elegant, functional, and timeless.

Architectural Bathroom Design Architecture and design come together to create harmony and balance. We refine the structure, proportion, and sightlines of your bathroom to achieve both comfort and sophistication. Every feature, from ceiling height to glass enclosures, double vanity placement, and window design, is thoughtfully considered. This ensures your bathroom feels like a true sanctuary while aligning perfectly with the architecture of your home.

Material & Finish Selection Luxury begins with curated materials and expert tile work, where every surface is set with precision for lasting beauty. We hand-select premium stone, tile, and new fixtures that complement your aesthetic and elevate your space through thoughtful floor and wall design. From subtle textures to statement pieces, every choice supports the design vision. Our close partnerships with high-end suppliers in Denver allow access to exclusive products not found in retail showrooms.

Cabinetry & Built-Ins Custom cabinetry brings warmth and function to your bathroom. We design every vanity and built-in to fit your proportions, enhance storage, and express your personal style. Each piece is crafted to integrate seamlessly with your materials and finishes, resulting in a space that feels complete and beautifully balanced.
Our Bathroom Design & Remodel Process

Every Rivington Marx Interiors project follows a thoughtful, proven process designed to make the experience as seamless as it is inspiring. From the first conversation to the final installation, every phase is guided by clarity, collaboration, and attention to detail.
Initial Consultation – We begin by understanding your goals, lifestyle, and vision for your home, setting the foundation for a truly personal design.
Concept Development – Curated palettes, materials, and layouts take shape, creating a cohesive direction for your project.
Design Development – We refine the details, finalize drawings, and confirm the design direction so every element feels intentional and cohesive.
Documentation & Procurement – Every selection is documented, vendors are coordinated, and lead times are tracked for a smooth workflow.
Construction Management – Our team provides consistent oversight to ensure craftsmanship, timelines, and design intent stay aligned.
Installation & Styling – From vanities and mirrors to lighting, hardware, and final styling details, we deliver a move-in-ready bathroom that feels complete in every detail.
Modern luxury bathroom featuring gold accents, double mirrors, and a spacious walk-in shower in Denver.
Featured in Houzz Jan 2026
The Rivington Marx Difference

Discerning homeowners choose Rivington Marx because our designs feel as authentic as they are luxurious. We don’t follow trends or repeat concepts. Each bathroom is a unique expression of your taste, your architecture, and your lifestyle.
Architectural Expertise – Every design begins with structure, proportion, and flow for long-term harmony.
True Exclusivity – Designs and material selections are unique to your project, ensuring your bathroom remains truly distinctive.
Seamless Collaboration – Our team coordinates design and construction with clarity and precision.
Award Recognition – Featured in LUXE Interiors + Design, House Beautiful, and Colorado Homes & Lifestyles for design excellence.
Denver Roots – As a locally based firm, we understand the architecture, style, and pace of Denver living.
View Our Portfolio

Our portfolio highlights spaces that blend architecture, artistry, and atmosphere in perfect balance. Each project tells its own story through material, light, and proportion, capturing the essence of how people live and feel in their homes.
Every detail reflects our belief that design should be both functional and inspiring, a natural extension of the client’s personality and lifestyle.
Begin Your Bathroom Transformation

Luxury bathroom design is about more than materials or layout. It’s about creating a space that restores you, every single day. Our Denver design team is ready to bring your vision to life through thoughtful planning, timeless craftsmanship, and a process that feels effortless from start to finish.
Request your private design consultation today , and let’s start shaping a bathroom that is entirely, unmistakably yours.
FAQs
How do I start my bathroom remodel with Rivington Marx Interiors?
Simply request a private design consultation. We’ll discuss your vision, assess your space, and outline a clear plan to begin your luxury bathroom transformation in Denver.
How much does a luxury bathroom remodel cost?

The cost of a luxury bathroom remodel in Denver varies based on size, layout changes, and the level of customization. Because every Rivington Marx design is unique, pricing is tailored to each project. During your consultation, we will evaluate your project and provide and estimated range of cost. Ultimately, pricing will be determined by material choices and final scope of work.
How long does a luxury bathroom remodel take?

Most bathroom remodels take between eight to twelve weeks to complete once concept is finalized and materials have been received. The timeline depends on the project scope, material selections, and the level of structural or custom work involved.
Do you handle both bathroom design and construction?

Yes. Rivington Marx Interiors provides both full service design and construction services in-house. Our unique ability to bring your entire project under one roof allows for both seamless execution of your design as well as a streamlined solution for your project that ensures the highest level of operational and cost efficiency.
Can you work within my existing bathroom layout?
Absolutely. We can refine your current layout to improve function, flow, and comfort without a complete structural change. Many clients choose this approach for smaller remodels or design updates.

Our Home Remodeling and Renovation Services

Kitchen remodeling: Kitchens are designed around how the space is used for cooking, gathering, and everyday movement. We focus on layout, storage, lighting, and materials that hold up to daily use.
Bathroom renovations: From primary baths to guest spaces, we balance comfort with durability. Good planning here improves both daily routines and long-term value.
Basement finishing: We turn underused basements into livable spaces, whether that means guest suites, media rooms, or flexible family areas with proper light and circulation.
Home additions: When a home needs more space, we design additions that feel like they have always belonged. Proportion, rooflines, and interior transitions matter just as much as square footage.
Historic home renovations: We work carefully within existing architecture, updating systems and layouts while respecting the character that makes these homes special.
Remodeling Older Homes in Denver
Many Denver homes were built decades ago, and they often need more than surface updates. Remodeling older properties requires experience with structure, systems, and thoughtful planning.

We regularly work in neighborhoods like Wash Park, Park Hill, Hilltop, Cherry Creek, Cherry Hills Village, Denver Country Club, and Capitol Hill, where homes often have strong bones but outdated layouts or infrastructure. Projects commonly involve reinforcing structure, opening floor plans safely, and upgrading electrical and plumbing systems to modern standards.
The goal is always the same. Preserve what gives the home its character while improving how it functions for today’s living.
A Glimpse Into Our Recent Projects
View our selection of recent projects that reflect our approach to design, craftsmanship, and lasting livability. Each project highlights a different challenge, home style, and functionality.
FAQs
How much does a home remodel cost in Denver?
Costs depend on the scope of work, size of the home, and level of finishes. Structural changes, system upgrades, and custom details all affect the final investment.
How long will my remodel take?
Timelines vary based on project complexity, permitting, and material lead times. We outline a realistic schedule early so expectations stay aligned.
Do you handle permits and inspections?
Yes. We manage permits, inspections, and coordination with local authorities as part of the process.
Can I stay in my home during construction?

Staying in your home during a remodel depends on the scope and your level of tolerance for disruption of daily living. We will discuss livability, safety, and disruption honestly before construction begins.
Is design build better than hiring separate contractors?
For many homeowners, working with one integrated team reduces miscommunication and keeps decisions aligned. It allows design intent and construction execution to move forward together.

A successful remodel comes from alignment between vision and execution. We guide each project with clarity, steady communication, and respect for the home.

pages.description: Premier Denver design build firm specializing in luxury residential design and whole home renovations. Seamless design, architecture, and construction. Request a consultation
paragraphs: At Rivington Marx Interiors, we create homes that feel cohesive, intentional, and functional. Design leads every decision, and construction follows that vision with expert craftsmanship and quality. Our design build process creates a smooth transition from design to completion, with an integrated team that works together at every stage of the project.
It all begins with a conversation
What Is a Design-Build Firm?

A design-build firm handles both design and construction under one roof, typically with one agreement and one team guiding the project from early concepts through the final walkthrough. Instead of hiring an interior designer and a separate contractor and hoping the handoff goes smoothly, the same team coordinates the vision, budget, schedule, and execution.

For homeowners, the notable difference is accountability and continuity. When design and build are working together from day one, there is less time translating decisions between vendors, and more attention can be devoted to the execution of the project rather than the logistics.
Why Choose a Design-Build Firm in Denver

Updating Denver homes can come with challenges such as unique historic charm, quirky layouts, older infrastructure, and strict permitting, all the while still striving to design the home to feel elegant, functional, and livable. A design-build firm is a smart fit to navigate all the pieces of a large remodel project with a smooth path from ideation to finished space.
Here is why many Denver homeowners choose this model.
One team, one direction: We keep design intent and construction reality aligned, so your home does not lose its point of view halfway through.

Fewer gaps between drawings and field work: Fine details that often need clarification, such as casing profiles, mitered or straight cuts, tile transitions, lighting placement, and built-in specs are communicated quickly between the design team and in-house construction team.
Better budget control as the design evolves: When changes are requested, or issues arise, we can line out the cost impact quickly and adjust with intention, not panic.
Faster decisions, cleaner timelines: No waiting on separate vendors to respond, price, revise, and reprice the same scope.
Less stress during a remodel: Clear communication, fewer unknowns, and a more predictable day-to-day experience, especially when renovating a primary home.
Our Design-First, Build-Smart Process
We treat design as the lead and construction as the support system that brings that design to life.
Discovery and vision alignment: We get clear on how you live, what you want the home to feel like, and what is not working in your current design, so every later decision has a north star.
Interior design and space planning : We develop layouts, elevations, and finish direction that solve function first, then elevate the mood with materials, color, texture, and proportion.
Budget modeling and value engineering: We budget in phases, identify cost drivers early, and refine the plan without flattening the character or quality.
Permitting and approvals: We coordinate drawings, documentation, and required inspections so the project moves forward with fewer stalls and fewer last-minute revisions.
Construction and project management: We manage the build, protect the details, and keep communication tight, so the work stays aligned with the original intent.
Final walkthrough and handoff: We walk the home with you, address punch list items, and hand off everything you need to live in the space confidently from day one.
Interior Design and Construction Under One Roof

When interior design and construction live under the same roof, decisions get made with the full picture in mind. Our designers work directly with the build team from the earliest planning stages, which means creative ideas are grounded in the structural nuances of the home. This collaboration reduces change orders and last-minute surprises.

Most importantly, the original design intent is protected through the collaboration of the in-house construction team. Details like proportion, material transitions, lighting placement, and custom elements are carried through from concept to completion, instead of being diluted during handoffs between separate firms.
Residential Design-Build Services
We provide design-build services in private homes always with a design-first approach.
Residential remodels and additions: Thoughtful updates and expansions that feel integrated with the original architecture, not tacked on.
Kitchen and bathroom design build: Highly detailed spaces where layout, materials, and craftsmanship matter as much as visual impact.
Whole home renovations: Comprehensive transformations that address flow, function, and atmosphere across the entire home.
Experience You Can See in the Results

Our experience shows up in the details, the flow of the spaces, and how the finished home feels from the moment you enter. Each project reflects a balance of thoughtful design from our experienced interior designer and disciplined craftsmanship.
View our past design-build projects to see how our approach comes together across different scales, styles, and uses.
FAQs
Is design-build more expensive?
Design-build is not inherently more expensive; instead, it is more transparent. Budgets are addressed earlier, which often reduces surprises, rework, and budget creep during construction.
Do you handle building permits?
Yes. We coordinate permitting and required approvals as part of the design build process, working within local municipality regulations and review timelines.
How long does a design-build project take?

Timelines vary based on scope, permitting, and complexity. Design build typically shortens the overall timeline by overlapping planning, pricing, and coordination instead of handling them in separate phases.
What types of projects are best for design-build?
Design build works well for whole home renovations, additions, kitchens, and bathrooms especially when coordination, budget clarity, and timeline control matter.
Let’s Design and Build It the Right Way

If you are planning a renovation or new build and want a clear, design-led path forward, design-build may be the right fit. We focus on creating spaces that feel intentional from the first sketch through the final walkthrough.
Reach out to start a conversation and see if our design-build approach aligns with your project and goals.

pages.description: Work with a leading Denver architectural interior designer who creates custom, architectural interiors tailored to your lifestyle. Rivington Marx delivers timeless, refined design.
paragraphs: Denver Architectural Interior Design & Planning Firm

Great design begins long before the finishing touches. At Rivington Marx Interiors, we lead with interior architecture to rework layouts, proportions, and flow so the home lives better and feels intentional.
It all begins with a conversation
What an Architectural Design Firm Actually Does

An interior architectural design firm focuses on how a home functions before laying out the aesthetics. The work begins by evaluating the space, structure, movement, and how rooms connect. Our designers observes not only the space but also small but impactful details, such as how light travels throughout the home during the day. These decisions shape the core functionality of the home before finishes or furniture are selected.

Instead of designing around an existing layout, interior architectural design evaluates whether the layout itself is working. It solves common issues homeowners face but cannot always name, like cramped kitchens, awkward transitions, poor sightlines, or rooms that never quite feel usable.
Interior architectural design typically involves:
Reworking layouts to improve flow and movement throughout the home
Evaluating walls, openings, and structural constraints
Planning for light, proportion, and spatial balance
Coordinating architecture and interiors as one system
The result is a home that feels calmer, clearer, and more intuitive to live in.
Architectural Design vs Interior Design
Architectural design shapes how a space works. Interior design refines how it looks and feels. Both matter, but architectural design sets the foundation that everything else relies on.

Interior architectural design decisions come first because they influence what is possible later. Once space, structure, and flow are resolved, finishes and furnishings can support the architecture instead of compensating for it.
When the architecture is established first, interior design decisions feel easier, more cohesive, and far more durable over time.
Why Hire an Interior Architectural Design Firm in Denver for Remodeling Projects

Denver homes can come with unique challenges, from historic layouts and older construction methods to newer builds that prioritize square footage over flow. Interior architectural design helps homeowners make smarter decisions before construction begins, when changes are easier and far less costly.

Working with a firm experienced in Denver homes allows layout and structural planning to align with local codes, permitting realities, and construction practices. This avoids common mid-project compromises that happen when design decisions are made too late.

Interior architectural design also helps homeowners see opportunities they may not recognize on their own, like reclaiming wasted circulation space, improving natural light, or correcting proportions that make rooms feel off without an obvious reason.
Our Architectural Design Process
Interior architectural design works best when it follows a clear, methodical process rooted in how people live.
Lifestyle and spatial needs assessment: We start by understanding how the home is lived in, where friction exists, and what needs to change to better support daily life.
Existing conditions analysis: The current structure, constraints, and opportunities are carefully reviewed before any layout decisions are made.
Space planning and layout concepts: We explore multiple layout directions to improve flow, proportion, and how rooms relate to one another.
Structural coordination: Walls, openings, and structural considerations are aligned with the design vision early to avoid surprises later.
Interior architectural drawings: Detailed drawings translate design intent into clear plans that builders and trades can rely on.
Construction-ready documentation: The final set provides clarity, coordination, and confidence before construction begins, reducing guesswork and unnecessary changes.
Our Architectural Design Services
Our services focus on shaping how the home works before focusing on how it looks. Each scope is approached with structure, flow, and long-term use in mind.
Our involvement includes:
Interior space planning: We evaluate how rooms relate to one another and adjust layouts to improve movement, comfort, and everyday function.
Layout reconfiguration: Existing walls and boundaries are reconsidered to eliminate wasted space and create clearer, more usable connections between rooms.
Kitchen and living space architecture: We design the core spaces of the home around circulation, sightlines, and real daily use, not trends or showroom layouts.
Bathroom interior architecture: Proportions, clearances, and sequencing are carefully planned so bathrooms feel calm, efficient, and well resolved.
Staircases and transitions: Stairs, landings, and in-between spaces are treated as architectural moments, not afterthoughts.
Material and detail coordination: Materials, junctions, and details are selected to support the architecture and maintain consistency throughout the home.
Remodel-ready documentation: Clear, coordinated drawings give builders and trades the information they need to build accurately and efficiently.
A Glimpse Into Our Interior Architectural Work

Our projects reflect a consistent focus on layout clarity, proportion, and thoughtful use of space. Each home is approached individually, with design decisions shaped by structure, light, and how the homeowners actually live.
FAQs
Do I need an architectural designer or an interior designer?

Projects that involve changing layouts, removing walls, or rethinking how spaces connect benefit from architectural design first. Interior design then builds on that foundation through materials, finishes, and furnishings.
Is architectural design only for major renovations?
No. Interior architectural design can be valuable for targeted remodels, kitchens, bathrooms, or any space where flow, proportion, or function feels off.
Can architectural design improve resale value?
Yes, when done well. Buyers respond to homes that feel intuitive, open, and well planned. Strong layouts and natural light often hold value longer than surface-level upgrades.
How does architectural design affect construction costs?

blocks.text: Denver Architectural Interior Design & Planning Firm

Great design begins long before the finishing touches. At Rivington Marx Interiors, we lead with interior architecture to rework layouts, proportions, and flow so the home lives better and feels intentional.
It all begins with a conversation
What an Architectural Design Firm Actually Does

An interior architectural design firm focuses on how a home functions before laying out the aesthetics. The work begins by evaluating the space, structure, movement, and how rooms connect. Our designers observes not only the space but also small but impactful details, such as how light travels throughout the home during the day. These decisions shape the core functionality of the home before finishes or furniture are selected.

Instead of designing around an existing layout, interior architectural design evaluates whether the layout itself is working. It solves common issues homeowners face but cannot always name, like cramped kitchens, awkward transitions, poor sightlines, or rooms that never quite feel usable.
Interior architectural design typically involves:
Reworking layouts to improve flow and movement throughout the home
Evaluating walls, openings, and structural constraints
Planning for light, proportion, and spatial balance
Coordinating architecture and interiors as one system
The result is a home that feels calmer, clearer, and more intuitive to live in.
Architectural Design vs Interior Design
Architectural design shapes how a space works. Interior design refines how it looks and feels. Both matter, but architectural design sets the foundation that everything else relies on.

Interior architectural design decisions come first because they influence what is possible later. Once space, structure, and flow are resolved, finishes and furnishings can support the architecture instead of compensating for it.
When the architecture is established first, interior design decisions feel easier, more cohesive, and far more durable over time.
Why Hire an Interior Architectural Design Firm in Denver for Remodeling Projects

Denver homes can come with unique challenges, from historic layouts and older construction methods to newer builds that prioritize square footage over flow. Interior architectural design helps homeowners make smarter decisions before construction begins, when changes are easier and far less costly.

Working with a firm experienced in Denver homes allows layout and structural planning to align with local codes, permitting realities, and construction practices. This avoids common mid-project compromises that happen when design decisions are made too late.

Interior architectural design also helps homeowners see opportunities they may not recognize on their own, like reclaiming wasted circulation space, improving natural light, or correcting proportions that make rooms feel off without an obvious reason.
Our Architectural Design Process
Interior architectural design works best when it follows a clear, methodical process rooted in how people live.
Lifestyle and spatial needs assessment: We start by understanding how the home is lived in, where friction exists, and what needs to change to better support daily life.
Existing conditions analysis: The current structure, constraints, and opportunities are carefully reviewed before any layout decisions are made.
Space planning and layout concepts: We explore multiple layout directions to improve flow, proportion, and how rooms relate to one another.
Structural coordination: Walls, openings, and structural considerations are aligned with the design vision early to avoid surprises later.
Interior architectural drawings: Detailed drawings translate design intent into clear plans that builders and trades can rely on.
Construction-ready documentation: The final set provides clarity, coordination, and confidence before construction begins, reducing guesswork and unnecessary changes.
Our Architectural Design Services
Our services focus on shaping how the home works before focusing on how it looks. Each scope is approached with structure, flow, and long-term use in mind.
Our involvement includes:
Interior space planning: We evaluate how rooms relate to one another and adjust layouts to improve movement, comfort, and everyday function.
Layout reconfiguration: Existing walls and boundaries are reconsidered to eliminate wasted space and create clearer, more usable connections between rooms.
Kitchen and living space architecture: We design the core spaces of the home around circulation, sightlines, and real daily use, not trends or showroom layouts.
Bathroom interior architecture: Proportions, clearances, and sequencing are carefully planned so bathrooms feel calm, efficient, and well resolved.
Staircases and transitions: Stairs, landings, and in-between spaces are treated as architectural moments, not afterthoughts.
Material and detail coordination: Materials, junctions, and details are selected to support the architecture and maintain consistency throughout the home.
Remodel-ready documentation: Clear, coordinated drawings give builders and trades the information they need to build accurately and efficiently.
A Glimpse Into Our Interior Architectural Work

Our projects reflect a consistent focus on layout clarity, proportion, and thoughtful use of space. Each home is approached individually, with design decisions shaped by structure, light, and how the homeowners actually live.
FAQs
Do I need an architectural designer or an interior designer?

Projects that involve changing layouts, removing walls, or rethinking how spaces connect benefit from architectural design first. Interior design then builds on that foundation through materials, finishes, and furnishings.
Is architectural design only for major renovations?
No. Interior architectural design can be valuable for targeted remodels, kitchens, bathrooms, or any space where flow, proportion, or function feels off.
Can architectural design improve resale value?
Yes, when done well. Buyers respond to homes that feel intuitive, open, and well planned. Strong layouts and natural light often hold value longer than surface-level upgrades.
How does architectural design affect construction costs?
Good architectural planning helps control costs by resolving decisions early. It reduces mid-construction changes, avoids wasted work, and gives builders clear direction.
Do you coordinate with engineers and builders?
Yes. We regularly coordinate with structural engineers, builders, and trades to keep design intent aligned with technical requirements and construction realities.

pages.description: Hear from our clients about how we’ve turned their vision into reality, creating unique spaces they love and cherish every day.
paragraphs: We asked Troy to help us dramatically modernize our home that had been originally designed in a Colorado mountain style, and we have continued to customize our design with him over the years. Beyond exceptional design talent, he displays stellar organization and communication skills to successfully bring any project, no matter how large and complex, to timely conclusion. We couldn’t recommend Troy more highly. He’s our go-to designer for complex projects and light touch zhuzhing too!
-GZ, Castle Pines North, CO

Troy is in class of his own. His designs are bold and inventive, he’s fearless with colors and patterns, curates interesting pieces everywhere and makes the process exciting and fun. Everyone who comes to our home is effusive about the paint colors and textures and cool design elements. In a market full of expensive but conservative designers, I enthusiastically recommend Troy because he brings real value – I can promise you he will take your design places you could not do on your own or with other designers. Troy approaches his work very seriously, but he also has a sense of humor and is quick to laugh. He and the team are assiduous to a degree no one else I have worked with comes close to; he uses the best subs and installers in town and is honest. I always thought his billing was transparent and reasonable, he’s surprisingly quick to respond to communications, and his team always followed up on any issues or changes long after the project was completed. Troy and his team are among the few designer/builder/installation groups in Denver that I give my highest recommendation.
-Dave, Denver, CO

I’m continuously on the hunt for new inspiration and one-of-a-kind pieces. I draw extensive creativity from the world around me and bring those ideas into my own home, which is an ever-evolving canvas that will never be complete. Sorry, Phillip (Troy’s husband)! That may be maddening to some, but it’s heaven to me!
-Troy Rivington, Denver, CO

Rather than go with a traditional arrangement in one of the rooms, as we wanted, Troy influenced our decision and took us out of our comfort zone. We are so grateful that he did. To this day, it is the most complimented and appreciated part of the design.
-Matt & Lance, Denver, CO

We purchased a 30-year-old house that had never been updated, knowing that Troy would be able to renovate it into our dream retirement home. The only design advice we could offer him was “California Breezy” and having it feel like a spa resort experience. Troy hit that mark well beyond our wildest expectations. In a realm that is often fraught with standardization, delay after delay, and double talk/lack of transparency, Troy is best in class at custom design, on time delivery, and stalwart honesty. Troy is the REAL DEAL!
-RB, Castle Pines, CO
When you’re in [the dining room], you can feel people light up. It’s as if they’re gathering some of the energy that was put into that space.
-Tim, Denver, CO

pages.title: Greenwood Village Interior Designer for Layered, Livable Homes
pages.description: Greenwood Village interior designer creating refined, livable homes through light, texture, and thoughtful design tailored to architecture and everyday living.
paragraphs: Greenwood Village sets the tone before you even step inside. The lots are often expansive, the landscaping mature, and the homes themselves range from stately brick estates to renovated Tuscan residences to newer mountain contemporary builds. That kind of variety calls for a design approach with both range and restraint.

In homes like these, the real work goes far beyond choosing finishes or placing furniture. Scale matters, so do sightlines, natural light, and the way one room connects to the next. When those details are handled well, the house feels settled, comfortable, and quietly confident.

At Rivington Marx Interiors , each project begins with the home itself. Some spaces call for a lighter touch. Others need contrast, texture, or a more defined point of view. The goal is not to flatten everything into sameness, but to create rooms that feel warm, clear, and deeply personal.
Key Summary:

A Greenwood Village interior designer starts with the architecture, then uses light, texture, and proportion to make larger homes feel more livable, connected, and resolved. At Rivington Marx Interiors, the goal is to create layered interiors that respect the home while bringing in a clearer and more personal point of view.
Understanding Greenwood Village Architecture

There is no single Greenwood Village house type, and that is part of what makes the area especially design-conscious. You will see traditional brick estates, Mediterranean and Tuscan homes from the late 1980s through early 2000s, and a growing number of modern rebuilds with larger expanses of glass and cleaner lines.

Some sit deep on the lot in enclaves like The Preserve. Others, especially in older pockets like Sundance Hills, carry renovation layers from different decades. Either way, the design has to account for arrival, privacy, and how the house connects to the surrounding grounds, patios, and outdoor living areas.

Step inside, and the challenge usually becomes clear pretty fast. High ceilings can make a room feel grand or oddly empty. Long sightlines can feel beautiful, but only if the spaces along the way relate to each other. Formal layouts often need a second look too, since many families live differently now than when these homes were first built.

In practice, that may mean softening a heavy Tuscan interior, reworking a living or dining room into something more useful, or keeping existing stone, ceiling detail, and millwork rather than removing everything and starting over. A good renovation does not fight the architecture. It studies the millwork, stonework, ceiling lines, and existing structure, then introduces a fresher, more livable point of view without losing the character that made the home worth preserving.
Light as Structure, Not Decoration

In Greenwood Village, light is not just about mood. It is a real design variable. Colorado’s altitude and bright, dry daylight affect how paint, plaster, textiles, wood tones, and stone surfaces read from morning into late afternoon. What feels soft in another market can look stark here if the palette is too cold or too flat.

A thoughtful designer accounts for that from the start. Window treatments often need to soften glare without giving up natural light or views. Material selections also have to hold up under stronger UV exposure. In the evening, layered lighting becomes even more important, especially in larger rooms that need warmth, structure, and a better sense of intimacy after sunset.
Texture Over Trend

Trends age quickly. Texture lasts. In refined interiors, materiality carries more weight than novelty, whether that shows up in plaster walls with subtle movement, natural stone with depth and variation, or millwork that feels crafted rather than factory-finished. These details create richly layered interiors that reward a second look.

Textiles add another layer of richness, especially wool, linen, silk, and velvet used in tonal palettes. Nothing needs to shout. The strongest rooms let classic architecture stay intact while bringing in contrast through shape, finish, and material balance. The result feels collected rather than overly styled, with enough depth to keep evolving over time.
Rooms That Feel Easy to Live In, Not Overworked
Rooms that feel effortless usually come from careful editing, strong proportion, and a clear point of view.
Living Spaces

Living rooms in Greenwood Village often come with generous scale. They need balance more than excess. Color can anchor the architecture, while art, upholstery, and lighting give the room personality. Seating should be arranged around proportion and circulation so the space feels inviting rather than oversized.
Statement lighting helps define scale and rhythm, especially in rooms with taller ceilings, broad footprints, or long sightlines.
Kitchens and Gathering Areas

Kitchens in Greenwood Village often open directly to patios, covered outdoor rooms, or rear entertaining areas, so materials need to hold up well and the transition from indoors to outdoors needs to feel natural. In many of these homes, the kitchen also acts as the main family gathering space, which means it has to balance beauty, daily function, and easy flow to the rooms around it.
That clarity usually comes down to a handful of decisions that help the kitchen feel connected rather than busy:
Cohesive material palettes that create visual calm
Custom cabinetry shaped by proportion and symmetry
Lighting that defines zones without fragmenting the space
Primary Suites

In primary suites, atmosphere leads, with an emphasis on comfort, privacy, and a real sense of retreat at the end of the day. Saturated but controlled palettes create mood without heaviness. Wall treatments introduce softness. Upholstery and bedding are layered for sensory depth.
The room should feel refined, but never cold. Clarity matters, though comfort matters too. Every element contributes to a sense of retreat shaped by craftsmanship and restraint.
Entertaining Spaces with Architectural Presence

Entertaining spaces in Greenwood Village are often more formal than what you see in newer urban homes. Dining rooms, libraries, and bars tend to have stronger architectural presence, so clarity of purpose matters. These rooms work best when they feel intentional, not simply decorative. That presence is shaped by a few defining elements:
Dining rooms anchored by statement lighting that defines scale
Bars shaped by darker finishes, warmer lighting, and stronger contrast
Libraries layered with millwork, patina, and collected objects
Rather than chasing novelty, these spaces rely on craftsmanship and atmosphere. They feel composed, considered, and designed to evolve over time.
Common Interior Design Priorities in Greenwood Village Homes

Many Greenwood Village homes come with strong architecture, but that does not always mean they feel current or easy to live in. A lot of design work here is about refining what is already there, making formal rooms more useful, improving continuity across large floorplans, and updating finishes without erasing the character of the home.
Softening dated Tuscan finishes without stripping away warmth
